description: Register an entity for ongoing ESG monitoring. DPX checks the score daily and fires a webhook when the composite score shifts by ≥ thresholdPoints. Satisfies MiCA Article 72 ongoing monitoring requirements. Returns a watchId for status checks and cancellation. Webhook payload includes previous/current score, delta, and tier change.

lei.description: 20-character GLEIF LEI of the entity to monitor.

thresholdPoints.description: Fire webhook if composite score changes by ≥ N points. Default 5. Minimum 1.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL to POST score change alerts to. Must be HTTPS.

name: esg.watch

baselineScore.description: Composite score at registration (used as first comparison point)

watchId.description: UUID — use to check status (GET /esg/watch/:id) or cancel (DELETE /esg/watch/:id)
